versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the simpleerp-db skill, a read-only Oracle SQL interface for the SimpleERP schema.
- Supports schema export, ad-hoc SELECT/WITH/EXPLAIN PLAN queries, and reference regeneration via npm scripts.
- Requires Oracle connection credentials: DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, and DB_CONNECT_STRING.
- Includes setup and usage documentation for both Linux/macOS and Windows environments.
- Provides detailed command references and agent policies for safe and effective use.
